The fortress moves into GlimStone, with the phrase as its only key, and a new glossary package keeps every app saying the same words in 42 languages.

## ✨ Added

- **The fortress in your Instances tab.** `Fortress`, `InstanceCard`, `FortressAppCard`, `FortressPermissions` and `FortressPairing` in React and Vue show your own instances first and the other apps behind one switch. Joining, leaving and showing the phrase come with their windows, a QR code included.
- **Take an instance out of the fortress.** Every row of another app ends in a quiet Remove, and the window names app and device before anything happens. Once the instance is out, the same window offers to change the phrase, since the old one would let it straight back in. Until you do, a line under the switch names who was removed, and the app that was taken out says so on its own page.
- **The pairing card can carry the whole fortress.** Show phrase sits beside Change, an app puts its own rows above the phrase and below Leave, and `renderApp` draws another app with the app's own card. The switch for the other apps can move into that card as well, with `hideSwitch` and `othersLine`.
<!-- open-anywhere -->
- **`@glimstone/terms`** holds nine shared words in 42 languages and checks an app's translations in CI. It points at the one translation that says "Relais" while everyone else says "Relay", with file and key.
- **`ListTable`** is the list of a list page with sorting, a filter per column, type to search and file manager picking already inside, so nobody has to hand-roll sort arrows again.
- **`Popover` and `Sheet`** live in the browser's top layer, where no card can clip them. A sheet slides in from the end edge and rises from the bottom on a phone.
- **`BusyRing` and `SkeletonRow`** wait 400 ms before they appear, so a quick answer never flashes a loader at you.
- **Field errors.** `TextField`, `TextArea`, `PasswordField` and `NumberField` take `error` and say under the field what is wrong. `FieldError` does the same for a field of your own.
- **`announce()`** lets a screen reader say things that have no element of their own, such as "3 rows selected".
- **A bilingual glossary on the site** names every element in English and German beside a live one. Every component also tags itself with `data-glim`, so a review tool knows what it is pointing at.
- **README buttons for Flatpak, MOS, ZimaOS and Umbrel**, each with its own mark and tile colour. A segment can carry its full name for screen readers through `label`.
- **`IconServer` and `IconLaptop`** join the glyphs, flat and drawn from the front like the rest of the family.
- **`form` on `Badge`** makes a badge rounded, square, pill or circle, whatever the shape setting thinks about it.

## 🎨 Design

- **The fortress gets its own section** in the design language. Your own instances come first, the other apps wait behind one switch, and changing the phrase or leaving happens only in the pairing settings.
- **Settings save without a button.** A setting shows a small confirmation once it is saved, and a window that only shows something closes with Close.
- **Popovers, sheets and waiting have sections of their own.** A value a field cannot take gets a line under the field rather than a toast and a shake.
- **A sub-card wears its title as a section badge in the notch**, and row tiles on a sub-card step up one surface, so they stop vanishing into it.
- **Rule 4 names the state colours GlimStone really uses**, and each of the four kinds of tile gets a name of its own.
- **A sign-in field keeps its label inside** until the first key.
- **The design language names no app.** Every rule stands on its own feet and keeps its reason.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A busy button shows the `BusyRing`**, which follows the motion level and holds still at "off".
- **Toasts reach every screen reader** through two live regions that stay in the page. A toast with an Undo waits until you have finished reading.
- **An open window makes everything behind it inert**, so the pointer and the screen reader stay inside as well as the keyboard.
- **The core compiles under `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`**, and the React and Vue packages build with the same check.
- **The phrase windows tell it like it is.** Changing the phrase says that apps which are away follow on their own for 30 days, and leaving names the current phrase as the way back, since the one you left with may have changed in the meantime.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The ink on accent fills holds up.** A switch that is on draws its knob in the contrast ink, and an app's own `a, button { color: inherit }` can't steal the colour from a filled button any more.
- **The Vue Info cards stop opening an empty tab** when they mount.
- **`readmeSoon` takes an empty list** without throwing.
- **Plugin pages name the class the companion plugin really sets**, `html.tt-popups-on`.
- **The site builds again** on a pinned Flutter 3.47.9.
- **The phrase row behaves on a phone.** Its two buttons wrap instead of running over the row's name at 390 px.
- **No double gap above the switch.** A fortress without cards of the app's own leaves its empty grid out.

## 🌐 Translations

- **The fortress speaks all 42 languages** of the glossary, plural forms included.
- **German says "Erlaubnis"** for what one app may start in another, because "Freigabe" is already busy naming shares.
